hints.title: Binary Conversion Score
hints.text: Convert hours into plus 1 for exhausting days (hours greater than 8) and minus 1 for other days.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Parity
hints.text: A subsegment is well-performing if its sum of scores is strictly positive.

hints.title: First Occurrence Mapping
hints.text: If cumulative score is positive, the whole prefix up to index i is valid. If non-positive, look for the first time score minus 1 appeared.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recording the first occurrence of each negative prefix sum allows O(1) span calculation per index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that prefix sums change by at most plus or minus 1 per step, making score minus 1 the optimal left boundary.
complexity.notes: Monotonic stack or first-seen lookup table both achieve O(N) time.
